name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Partition work into lanes and mergeable modules, then schedule module and task DAGs across worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Plan parallel worktrees and draft bounded agent prompts.
interface.longDescription: Partition implementation goals into architecture lanes and independently mergeable modules; derive a module quotient DAG from task dependencies; show compact module cards and Mermaid topology in conversation; draft bounded coding-agent prompts; and advance work through human-approved two-level Kahn scheduling across worktrees.
interface.defaultPrompt: Partition this goal into architecture lanes and independently mergeable modules, derive the module and task DAGs, show concise module cards and Mermaid topology, draft a bounded coding-agent prompt for every task, and guide manual two-level Kahn execution.
